def transform(g):

    from collections import Counter
    allc=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    def linecolor_unique(vals):

    vert=[c for c in range(W) if len(set(g[r][c] for r in range(H)))==1 and linecolor_unique([g[r][c] for r in range(H)])]
